import json

data = json.loads(files)
entries = data["entries"]

# Build a tree structure from paths
tree = {}
for entry in entries:
    path = entry["path"].replace("/workspace/", "")
    parts = path.split("/")
    current = tree
    for part in parts[:-1]:
        current = current.setdefault(part + "/", {})
    size = entry.get("size_bytes", 0)
    current[parts[-1]] = size

def print_tree(node, prefix="", is_last=True):
    lines = []
    items = sorted(node.items(), key=lambda x: (not x[0].endswith("/"), x[0]))
    for i, (name, value) in enumerate(items):
        last = (i == len(items) - 1)
        connector = "└── " if last else "├── "
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            lines.append(f"{prefix}{connector}{name}")
            extension = "    " if last else "│   "
            lines.extend(print_tree(value, prefix + extension, last))
        else:
            size_str = f" ({value:,} bytes)" if value else ""
            lines.append(f"{prefix}{connector}{name}{size_str}")
    return lines

tree_lines = print_tree(tree)
output = "\n".join(tree_lines)
print(f"Total files: {len(entries)}\n")
print(output)
